description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Notify the Promulgate regulations for the purpose of governing business to consumer (B2C) transactions on the e-commerce Platform - These regulations were effective from 01.07.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification contains new regulations governing business-to-consumer (B2C) e-commerce transactions, promulgated under the Customs Ordinance. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for customs procedures, documentation requirements, and compliance rules for various types of enterprises engaged in B2C operations. The content focuses on creating regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
